project: SIH1379 - AI-Powered Transmission Corridor Vegetation Risk Intelligence System
description: Canonical data source registry for vegetation risk intelligence pipeline. All sources are official, publicly accessible, and documented with tier priority, access method, and usage notes.

tier_definitions.tier_1_required: Must-have for MVP. Core functionality depends on these sources.
tier_definitions.tier_2_recommended: Strongly recommended for MVP. Significantly improves accuracy/robustness.
tier_definitions.tier_3_advanced: Advanced/optional. For future phases or specific use cases.

data_sources.name: Sentinel-2 Level-2A Surface Reflectance
data_sources.usage: NDVI computation, vegetation fraction, vegetation condition proxy
limitations: 10m resolution cannot resolve individual trees near conductors
Cloud cover affects acquisition - quality metadata stored per result
No canopy height - NDVI is proxy, not direct fall/contact measurement
No historical incident/ground truth for supervised ML

data_sources.name: ESA WorldCover 10m Land Cover
data_sources.access_method: STAC API (via Microsoft Planetary Computer mirror)
data_sources.usage: Distinguish woody vegetation (trees/shrubs) from non-woody (crops/grass) - critical for disambiguating NDVI-high cropland vs. tree risk
limitations: Static product (2020/2021) - may not reflect current conditions
10m resolution matches Sentinel-2 but same spatial limitation

data_sources.name: NASA GEDI L2A Canopy Height

metrics.rh_50: Relative height 50th percentile (m) - median canopy height

data_sources.coverage: Sparse - ~25m footprints along orbital tracks, NOT continuous wall-to-wall
data_sources.usage: Direct canopy height measurement where available. Used for fall distance/reach estimation.
limitations: SPARSE coverage - ~25m footprints along tracks, large gaps between tracks
Missing GEDI coverage MUST be represented explicitly - do NOT interpolate/invent height
Quality flag threshold required (quality_flag >= 1 for reliable data)
data_sources.fallback_behavior: If Earth Engine unavailable, marks UNAVAILABLE and continues with Sentinel-2 + WorldCover only

data_sources.name: Copernicus DEM (GLO-30 / GLO-90)
data_sources.access_method: STAC API (Copernicus Data Space) or AWS Open Data (SRTM fallback)
data_sources.usage: Terrain elevation, slope, aspect, hillshade for terrain context and fall direction estimation
data_sources.critical_note: DEM elevation is NOT canopy height. Canopy height comes from GEDI (Tier 2), NOT from DEM.
limitations: DSM (Digital Surface Model) includes vegetation/building tops - NOT bare earth DTM
SRTM fallback (90m) if Copernicus DEM unavailable

data_sources.name: NASA POWER (Prediction Of Worldwide Energy Resources)
data_sources.usage: Seasonal vegetation growth context - monsoon periods, drought/stress, growing degree days, water stress index
data_sources.critical_note: Weather data provides CONTEXT for vegetation growth analysis. Do NOT directly convert rainfall into risk score without validation. Use weather to understand seasonal patterns and data quality context for satellite observations.
limitations: 0.5° resolution (~50km) - coarse for local corridor scale
Point query at AOI centroid - not spatially distributed

tier_3.name: Bhuvan LULC (Land Use Land Cover)
tier_3.description: India-specific land cover with finer classes relevant to Indian transmission corridors. Complements ESA WorldCover for India AOIs.
tier_3.notes: Requires Bhuvan portal access/API. Not yet integrated.

tier_3.name: Sentinel-1 SAR (C-band)
tier_3.description: All-weather, day/night SAR imagery. Can penetrate cloud cover. Useful for flood mapping, soil moisture, and vegetation structure.
tier_3.notes: Requires SAR processing expertise. Not yet integrated.

tier_3.name: ICESat-2 ATLAS/08 Land and Vegetation Height
tier_3.description: Photon-counting LiDAR with ~17m footprint, denser than GEDI in some regions. Complementary canopy height source.
tier_3.notes: Different orbital characteristics than GEDI. Not yet integrated.

pipeline_stages.stage_2_vegetation: NDVI computation, vegetation masking (optionally filtered by WorldCover woody mask)
pipeline_stages.stage_3_spatial: Distance to line, corridor edge, tower proximity using transmission infrastructure GeoJSON
pipeline_stages.stage_4_temporal: NDVI change detection between dates (if multi-date)
pipeline_stages.stage_5_features: Per-corridor-segment feature table combining all sources
pipeline_stages.stage_6_risk: Weighted heuristic risk scoring with explainable breakdown

disclaimer: This system is a decision-support / inspection-prioritization platform. It does NOT claim Sentinel-2 alone can determine whether a specific tree will physically contact a conductor. Risk scores are corridor-segment-level (10m resolution), not tree-level.
